日.meaningMnemonic: On its own, the kanji for day also means the sun itself, the thing that makes the day.
日.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi ひ. Picture the sun so hot you shout "hee!" when it touches your skin.

一つ.meaningMnemonic: The kanji for one plus the little つ ending is how you count one thing.
一つ.readingMnemonic: This uses the kun'yomi ひと plus つ. The つ ending is the native Japanese way of counting objects.

一日.meaningMnemonic: One plus day gives one day, or a whole day from morning to night.
一日.readingMnemonic: Both kanji use their on'yomi: いち from one and にち from day, which you already know.

一.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji is just the number one.
一.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi いち, the same itch you remember from the kanji.

国.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means a country or a region.
国.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi くに, not the cook reading. Picture the royal cook saying "coo, nee" as he looks over his country.

一人.meaningMnemonic: One plus person means one person, or being all alone.
一人.readingMnemonic: This is an irregular reading: ひとり. Learn it as a whole word; it does not use いち or じん.

人.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means a person, someone.
人.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi ひと, the same ひと you saw in 一人.

一人一人.meaningMnemonic: One person, then one person again: each person, one by one.
一人一人.readingMnemonic: It is simply ひとり said twice: ひとりひとり.

年.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means a year, or a person's age in years.
年.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi とし, not the nun reading. Picture the nun counting years on her toes, "toe, she" says.

大人.meaningMnemonic: A large person is a grown up, an adult.
大人.readingMnemonic: This is an irregular reading, おとな. It does not use だい or じん; learn it as one word.

大きい.meaningMnemonic: The kanji for large plus the い ending makes the adjective big.
大きい.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi おお plus きい, so おおきい. Picture someone shouting "oh!" at something big.

大きな.meaningMnemonic: Another way to say big, used right before a noun.
大きな.readingMnemonic: Same おお as 大きい, but it ends in きな instead of きい: おおきな.

大いに.meaningMnemonic: Large turned into an adverb: very much, greatly.
大いに.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi おお plus いに: おおいに.

大した.meaningMnemonic: Large in importance: something considerable or great.
大した.readingMnemonic: Here the kanji uses its other on'yomi たい, plus した: たいした.

大.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means large or great, often as a size label.
大.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi だい, the purple dye from the kanji.

十日.meaningMnemonic: Ten plus day gives ten days, or the tenth day of the month.
十日.readingMnemonic: This is a special date reading: とおか. Ten is read とお here and day is read か.

十.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji is the number ten.
十.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi じゅう, the jewel from the kanji.

二つ.meaningMnemonic: Two plus the つ counting ending: two things.
二つ.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi ふた plus つ: ふたつ.

二人.meaningMnemonic: Two plus person: two people, a pair.
二人.readingMnemonic: Like 一人, this is irregular: ふたり. Learn it together with ひとり.

二日.meaningMnemonic: Two plus day: two days, or the second day of the month.
二日.readingMnemonic: A special date reading: ふつか. It does not use に or にち.

二.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji is the number two.
二.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi に, the knee from the kanji.

二十日.meaningMnemonic: Twenty plus day: twenty days, or the twentieth day of the month.
二十日.readingMnemonic: A special reading: はつか. Learn it as one word, because none of the usual readings appear.

二十.meaningMnemonic: Two tens make twenty; this word means twenty years old.
二十.readingMnemonic: When it means twenty years old, it has its own reading: はたち. A big birthday gets a special word.

本.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means a book.
本.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi ほん, the honk from the kanji.

本人.meaningMnemonic: The book's own person: the person in question, the one themselves.
本人.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: ほん plus にん, the second reading of person.

日本.meaningMnemonic: The sun's origin: the land where the sun rises, Japan.
日本.readingMnemonic: Day becomes に and book stays ほん: にほん. The stronger form にっぽん doubles the sound.

中.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means the inside of something.
中.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi なか. Picture the inside of a box so dark you say "nah, ka" and back away.

中々.meaningMnemonic: Inside, then inside again: quite deeply, so very or considerably.
中々.readingMnemonic: It is なか said twice: なかなか. The 々 mark repeats the kanji before it.

年中.meaningMnemonic: Inside the year: all year round.
年中.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi, with a sound change: ねん plus じゅう, so ねんじゅう. The ちゅう of inside picks up a voiced sound.

日中.meaningMnemonic: Inside the day: during the daytime.
日中.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: にち plus ちゅう, squeezed into にっちゅう.

長い.meaningMnemonic: The kanji for long plus the い ending: the adjective long.
長い.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi なが plus い: ながい.

出る.meaningMnemonic: Exit as a verb: to leave or to go out.
出る.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi で plus る: でる.

出す.meaningMnemonic: To make something exit: to take it out or put it out.
出す.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi だ plus す: だす. Compare でる, where you go out yourself.

出かける.meaningMnemonic: To exit the house on an outing: to go out.
出かける.readingMnemonic: It starts with the kun'yomi で, then かける: でかける.

三日.meaningMnemonic: Three plus day: three days, or the third day of the month.
三日.readingMnemonic: A special date reading: みっか. Three is read みっ and day is read か.

三つ.meaningMnemonic: Three plus the つ counting ending: three things.
三つ.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi みっ plus つ: みっつ.

三.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji is the number three.
三.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi さん, the sand from the kanji.

時々.meaningMnemonic: Time, then time again: from time to time, sometimes.
時々.readingMnemonic: It is とき said twice, and the second one softens to どき: ときどき.

一時.meaningMnemonic: One plus hour: one o'clock, or one moment in time.
一時.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: いち plus じ, the jeep from the kanji: いちじ.

時.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means time or a moment.
時.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi とき, not the jeep reading.

行く.meaningMnemonic: Going as a verb: to go.
行く.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi い plus く: いく.

行う.meaningMnemonic: Going about a task: to perform or carry it out.
行う.readingMnemonic: It uses the longer kun'yomi おこな plus う: おこなう.

行き.meaningMnemonic: The going part of a trip: the way there.
行き.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi い plus き: いき.

見る.meaningMnemonic: See as a verb: to see or to watch.
見る.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi み plus る: みる.

見せる.meaningMnemonic: To make someone see: to show.
見せる.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi み plus せる: みせる.

見つける.meaningMnemonic: To see something you were looking for: to find it.
見つける.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi み plus つける: みつける.

見える.meaningMnemonic: To be seeable: to be visible or in sight.
見える.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi み plus える: みえる.

見つかる.meaningMnemonic: To get seen at last: to be found.
見つかる.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi み plus つかる: みつかる. Compare みつける, where you do the finding.

一月.meaningMnemonic: One plus month: a span of one month.
一月.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi ひと plus つき: ひとつき.

月.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means the Moon, or a month.
月.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi つき, not the get reading.

年月.meaningMnemonic: Years and months together: a long stretch of time.
年月.readingMnemonic: Both kun'yomi: とし plus つき: としつき.

後ろ.meaningMnemonic: Behind as a place: the back or the rear.
後ろ.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi うし plus ろ: うしろ.

後.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means after, or what comes behind.
後.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi あと, not the goat reading.

前.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means the front, or before.
前.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi まえ, not the zen reading.

生まれる.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi う plus まれる: うまれる.

生きる.meaningMnemonic: Life as a verb: to live.
生きる.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi い plus きる: いきる.

生じる.meaningMnemonic: To bring something to life: to produce or cause it.
生じる.readingMnemonic: It uses the on'yomi しょう plus じる: しょうじる.

生.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means life or living.
生.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi せい, the say from the kanji.

一生.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi, squeezed: いち plus しょう becomes いっしょう.

生まれ.meaningMnemonic: Your birth, or the place you were born.
生まれ.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi う plus まれ: うまれ, like 生まれる without the る.

人生.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: じん plus せい, the gin and the say: じんせい.

五つ.meaningMnemonic: Five plus the つ counting ending: five things.
五つ.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi いつ plus つ: いつつ.

五.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji is the number five.
五.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi ご, the goat from the kanji.

五日.meaningMnemonic: Five plus day: five days, or the fifth day of the month.
五日.readingMnemonic: A special date reading: いつか. Five is read いつ and day is read か.

時間.meaningMnemonic: The interval of time: time, an hour, a period.
時間.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: じ plus かん, the jeep and the can: じかん.

間.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means the space between things.
間.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi あいだ, not the can reading.

人間.meaningMnemonic: The one between people: a human being.
人間.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: にん plus けん, and けん softens to げん: にんげん.

年間.meaningMnemonic: The span of a year: during a year.
年間.readingMnemonic: Both on'yomi: ねん plus かん, the nun and the can: ねんかん.

上げる.meaningMnemonic: To move something above: to raise it.
上げる.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi あ plus げる: あげる.

上.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji means above or on top.
上.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi うえ, not the joker reading.

上る.meaningMnemonic: To go above: to rise or go up.
上る.readingMnemonic: Here it uses the kun'yomi あ plus がる, so あがる, like あげる but going up by itself.

東.readingMnemonic: Alone it uses the kun'yomi ひがし, not the toe reading.

四日.meaningMnemonic: Four plus day: four days, or the fourth day of the month.
四日.readingMnemonic: A special date reading: よっか. Four is read よっ and day is read か.

四つ.meaningMnemonic: Four plus the つ counting ending: four things.
四つ.readingMnemonic: It uses the kun'yomi よっ plus つ: よっつ.

四.meaningMnemonic: Alone, the kanji is the number four.
四.readingMnemonic: Alone it keeps the on'yomi し, the sheep from the kanji. People also say よん.
